item.title: Gold drops more than 1% on US rate-hike bets
item.description: Gold prices fell more than 1% on Monday as a rise in oil prices heightened inflation concerns and reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
item.dc:creator: Ashitha Shivaprasad
item.content:encoded: Gold prices fell more than 1% on Monday as a rise in oil prices heightened inflation concerns and reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. Spot gold was down 1.5% at $4,223.95 per ounce, as of 0117 GMT. US gold futures fell 1.5% to $4,257.90. "The high bond yields and high oil price tandem continues to act as a thorn in gold’s side. Oil prices have risen on mixed signals about oil flows, which is keeping inflation front and centre for investors," said Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade. [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"Iran"] insisted that only diplomacy can solve its conflict with the United States and Israel, after US President Donald Trump said he rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting. Oil prices rebounded more than 1%. The Fed raised rates earlier this month, lifting its target rate range by a quarter percentage point to between 3.75% and 4%. Traders are pricing in a 66% chance of a US rate hike in October, according to CME's FedWatch Tool. Higher energy prices can fuel inflation by raising costs across the economy. Gold is widely viewed as a hedge against inflation, but a high interest rate environment increases the opportunity cost of holding the non-yielding metal. Investors will watch a run of US labour market and inflation data this week, including job openings, the ADP employment report, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and nonfarm payrolls. "Stronger-than-expected inflation or employment numbers could keep upward pressure on bond yields and weigh further on gold," Waterer said. Cleveland Fed President [USN:L6N45H10Y TEXT:"Beth Hammack"] said on Friday she is concerned that persistently high inflation risks conditioning the American public to accept elevated prices as the norm, adding the central bank cannot let that happen. Among other metals, spot silver fell 2.6% to $62.64 per ounce, platinum was down 2.1% at $1,741.45 and palladium lost 2.1% to $1,239.95.

item.title: 英首相、次期総選挙で社会的ケア改革争点に 就任後初の党大会
item.description:
Elizabeth Piper Andrew MacAskill
[リバプール ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elizabeth Piper　Andrew MacAskill

[リバプール ２７日 ロイター] - バーナム英首相は２７日、社会的ケアの危機に対処するための計画を次期総選挙で提示すると表明した。利用時は無料とし、費用は国民全体で広く負担する仕組みにするという。

首相就任後初となる労働党大会の初日、バーナム氏は英ＢＢＣのインタビューで社会的ケアに関する構想を打ち出した。多額のコストを伴うこの問題について、今月初めに父親が介護施設で亡くなったことから、自身にとって強く共感する課題だと述べた。

ただ、この問題を優先課題の一つに挙げながらも、２０２９年半ばまでに実施される次期総選挙まで具体的な計画は示さない方針を明らかにした。目先の大幅増税を回避したい政府にとっては、一定の安心感をもたらした。

バーナム氏は「私はこの問題でリーダーシップを発揮する。難しい問いから逃げるつもりはない。言い換えれば、絆創膏を一気に剥がすつもりだ。誰かがやらなければならない」と強調。

「その計画は総選挙で国民に問う。そこで計画が試されることになる。困難を伴うかもしれないし、一部の人々からは不評を買うかもしれないと承知の上で、私はその立場に身を置く覚悟だ」と述べた。

英国では歴代首相が社会的ケア改革に取り組んだものの、いずれも失敗してきた。現状では、介護施設に入所する人々が高額な費用を賄うために自宅を売却したり借金を負ったりせざるを得ないケースが少なくない。

財政への懸念に対応するため歳出削減の分野も示す用意があるかとの問いに対し、バーナム氏は今週の党大会でその用意があることを示すと述べた。

英国では借り入れコストが高水準にあり、社会保障費は膨らみ、エネルギーコストも上昇している。

バーナム氏はまず、生活費高騰にあえぐ多くの国民の負担を和らげることが自身の望みだと語った。

「この職務でできることのために、私はこの仕事を望んでいる。私が何をしようとしているのか、国民が疑いを抱くことはないだろう」とし、「ブレグジット以降続いてきた１０年間の漂流と分断を終わらせるために、私はここにいる」と語った。

item.title: Oregon QB Dante Moore sustained concussion on late hit vs. USC
item.description: Oregon star quarterback Dante Moore sustained a concussion on a late hit against Southern California but did not have any other injuries, Ducks head coach Dan Lanning announced on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oregon star quarterback Dante Moore sustained a concussion on a late hit against Southern California but did not have any other injuries, Ducks head coach Dan Lanning announced on Sunday. Moore was carted off the field following a hit by linebacker Desman Stephens II in the first half of then-No. 20 Oregon's 41-27 victory over the then-No. 12 Trojans on Saturday night in Los Angeles. "Dante sustained a concussion in last night's game, but fortunately his MRI and CT scans came back clean and he did not suffer any additional injuries," Lanning said in a statement. "Every concussion is different, and we are going to move forward with an abundance of caution to ensure we make the best decisions for Dante and his future." An Oregon spokesperson said after the game that Moore had movement in all of his extremities and was being evaluated. "We are extremely appreciative of our entire medical staff and the medical staffs at USC and LA General (Medical Center) for their quick and thorough action in making sure Dante received the very best care possible," Lanning said in his statement on Sunday. During the play, which came with 10:06 remaining in the second quarter, the senior quarterback took off on a scramble. When attempting to slide, he was hit in the head by Stephens, who was called for targeting and disqualified from the game. Fights broke out between players at midfield while Moore lay on the ground, and both teams were penalized for unsportsmanlike conduct. Southern California suspended Stephens for one game, this Saturday against Washington, for his conduct after the play, Trojans head coach Lincoln Riley announced on Sunday. Stephens celebrated on the field after the hit, even after he was called for targeting, and stayed on the sideline in sweatpants after being ejected. "Desman's actions in last night's game are unacceptable and are not reflective of USC Football nor of his personal character," Riley said in a statement. "He understands his mistake, accepts the consequences of his actions and will learn from this. The entire Trojan Family wishes Dante a full recovery, and we send our best regards to him and his family." Stephens issued an apology Sunday, expressing regrets for his actions. "Seeing a player injured like that is incredibly serious, and my reaction in the moments afterward was completely inappropriate and inexcusable," Stephens said in the statement. "Regardless of what was going through my mind at the time, there is no justification for smiling or celebrating while another player receives medical attention. I take full responsibility for my actions. That is not the person or teammate I want to be, and I will learn from this. I am deeply sorry to Dante, his family and everyone who saw my reaction. It is not representative of USC or our program. I hope he makes a full and speedy recovery." Backup quarterback Dylan Raiola, who transferred from Nebraska, took over in Moore's place. Raiola was 19 of 25 for 289 yards and two touchdown passes. Moore was an All-Big Ten third-team selection last season, throwing for 3,565 yards, 30 touchdowns and 10 interceptions as the team went 13-2. He has completed 69 of 99 attempts (69.7%) for 926 yards, nine touchdowns and no interceptions this season. He was 8 of 10 for 77 yards on Saturday. No. 15 Oregon (3-1) has a bye week before playing host to current No. 23 UCLA (4-0) on Oct. 10 in Eugene. --Field Level Media

item.title: China industrial profits rise 15.7% in January-August
item.description: Profits at China's industrial firms grew 15.7% in the first eight months of 2026 from a year earlier, official data showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Profits at China's industrial firms grew 15.7% in the first eight months of 2026 from a year earlier, official data showed on Monday. Growth eased from a 17.6% increase in the January-to-July period, according to data from the National Bureau of Statistics. Industrial profit figures cover firms with yearly revenue of at least 20 million yuan ($2.98 million) from their main operations. ($1 = 6.7002 Chinese yuan)

item.title: Costa Rica pierde ante Haití y sufre segunda derrota en Liga de Naciones Concacaf
item.description: La selección de fútbol de Costa Rica perdió el domingo por 2-0 ante Haití y quedó al borde de la eliminación al sufrir su segunda derrota seguida en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf, resultado que podría ocasionar el cese del argentino Fernando "Bocha" Batista como director técnico de la selección centroamericana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La selección de fútbol de Costa Rica perdió el domingo por 2-0 ante Haití y quedó al borde de la eliminación al sufrir su segunda derrota seguida en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf, resultado que podría ocasionar el cese del argentino Fernando "Bocha" Batista como director técnico de la selección centroamericana. Costa Rica, que en su primer partido del torneo fue derrotado por Curazao por 4-3 tras perder una ventaja de tres goles como local, se quedó en el último lugar del Grupo A de la Liga A, y con escasas opciones de avanzar a los cuartos de final, instancia a la que clasifican los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos. "Es muy duro y difícil hablar en este momento, tenemos que analizar en lo interno lo que nos está pasando. En el primer tiempo nos meten los goles por descuido de nosotros, quedan dos partidos más, hay que levantar la cabeza y seguir para adelante", dijo a la transmisión oficial de la Concacaf el zaguero y capitán de Costa Rica, Francisco Calvo. Los costarricenses intentaron lavarse la cara ante los haitianos y trataron de presionar durante todo el juego, pero sin contundencia. En cambio, Haití jugó con más confianza y desde la primera parte logró vencer al portero "tico" Abraham Madriz en dos ocasiones para afianzar su buen ritmo tras ganar a Trinidad y Tobago por 3-2 en su presentación de la competencia. En el inicio del partido, disputado en el estadio Sabina Park de Kingston, Costa Rica generó algunas opciones que no lograron concretar, y fue la selección de Haití la que se puso en ventaja al minuto nueve con un disparo de Jean Bellegarde desde fuera del área, metiendo el balón pegado al poste izquierdo. Costa Rica se vio desconcertada, lo que aprovechó Haití para empezar a dominar el encuentro y meter el segundo gol a los 39 minutos cuando Calvo anotó en su propia portería al tratar de desviar un remate de Fafà Picault, quien le ganó la espalda a un defensor costarricense para rematar en el área chica un centro enviado por Martin Expérience. Para la segunda parte, Batista realizó algunas modificaciones, lo que generó que Costa Rica se viera un poco más ordenada y controlara un poco más el partido, pero no pudo marcar. Al final del partido, los jugadores de Haití se acercaron a las gradas para despedirse de sus aficionados y agradecerles el apoyo. El siguiente compromiso de la selección "tica" será el 1 de octubre cuando visite a Nicaragua, y tres días después cerrará la fase de grupos en casa ante Haití. "Confío a muerte en mi trabajo, confío en mi grupo", dijo Batista. Más tarde, en los otros partidos del Grupo A, Curazao enfrentará a Nicaragua y República Dominicana visitará a Trinidad y Tobago. El lunes se disputará la segunda jornada del Grupo B con los partidos entre Jamaica-Honduras, Guatemala-El Salvador y Surinam-Martinica. El Salvador, Jamaica y Surinam ganaron a Martinica, Guatemala y Honduras, respectivamente, en sus primeros compromisos del torneo. El sector lo lidera El Salvador con tres puntos, los mismos que registran Surinam y Jamaica, pero una mayor diferencia de goles. Los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos avanzarán a los cuartos de final, donde se unirán a las selecciones de México, Estados Unidos, Canadá y Panamá, que llegaron directamente a esa instancia por ser las mejores clasificadas de la Concacaf. Los ganadores de la fase de los cuartos de final clasificarán directamente a la Copa Oro del 2027. La Liga de Naciones es una competencia de selecciones nacionales lanzada por la Concacaf en 2018 para garantizar que las 41 Asociaciones Miembro de Concacaf compitan regularmente en partidos oficiales entre las Copas Mundiales. Estados Unidos la ganó en 2021, 2023 y 2024. México logró el título en 2025.

item.title: トランプ氏、ＡＩ技術で中国と協力望まず 「米が大きくリード」
item.description: [ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、先に訪米した中国の習近平国家主席と人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡り「重要な話し合い」を行ったとしながらも、米国はこの技術で中国と協力すべきではないとの考えを示した。

ホワイトハウスで記者団に、自身が用いる「スーパーインテリジェンス（超知能、ＳＩ）」の呼称を使い、「われわれはＳＩについて重要な話し合いをした」と説明。

一方、「中国が望むのはわれわれの進歩を止めることだ。われわれが中国を大きくリードしているからで、その状態を維持していく。この件についての話し合いにはさほど多くの時間を割かなかった」と述べた。

また「われわれが大きくリードしているため、（ＡＩに関する取り組みを）統合したくはない。リードしているときには互いにオープンにはしないものだ」と述べた。

item.title: Dollar firms as US-Iran tensions lift oil, hawkish Fed bets build
item.description: The dollar inched higher to hold near a two-month high on Monday, as the US-Iran standoff continued to push up oil prices while investors looked ahead to a data-packed week for more clues on inflation and central banks' moves.
item.dc:creator: Jiaxing Li
item.content:encoded: The dollar inched higher to hold near a two-month high on Monday, as the US-Iran standoff continued to push up oil prices while investors looked ahead to a data-packed week for more clues on inflation and central banks' moves. The euro and sterling were both 0.1% weaker against the dollar, last at $1.1379 and $1.3232, respectively, hovering near multi-month lows against the greenback. The dollar index , which measures the US currency against a basket of peers, was a touch higher at 101.15 and on track for a 1.7% gain in September, its best month since June. Oil prices [USN:L4N45J03L TEXT:"climbed"] more than 1% on Monday with Brent crude futures last above $106 a barrel, after US President Donald Trump [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"rejected"] a peace deal with Iran to resolve their conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Energy supply risks and [USN:L1N45H0BU TEXT:"robust fundamentals"] in the US have heightened inflation concerns and prompted traders to price in a more [USN:L6N45H10Y TEXT:"hawkish Federal Reserve"], while elevated long-end [USN:L6N45H0ZD TEXT:"Treasury yields"] also supported the dollar. "The greenback could overshoot in the near term if energy market tensions persist and inflation risks continue to build," said Sim Moh Siong, FX strategist at OCBC. The bank's base case remains for a moderate USD rally into year-end, he added. The market's focus is set to turn to US data releases as the week unfolds, with the PCE Index (USPCEM=ECI) on Wednesday and non-farm payrolls (USNFAR=ECI) on Friday both expected to be consistent with further policy tightening. Currently, markets are seeing a 65% chance of a rate hike from the Fed when the central bank meets next at the end of October, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool. Other data for the week include China PMIs (CNPMIB=ECI) on Wednesday ahead of the week-long National Day holidays and Japan (JPCPIT=ECI) and euro zone CPIs (EUHICF=ECI) on Friday. The yen was last down 0.3% at 157.7 per dollar. It gained on Friday after Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [USN:L1N45H0E7 TEXT:"held a call"] on Friday and reaffirmed that yen undervaluation is a matter of concern and that the two nations intend to strengthen cooperation. The Australian dollar fetched $0.7017 , down 0.07%, and the kiwi traded flat at $0.5661 . The Reserve Bank of Australia is expected to [USN:L4N45F18Y TEXT:"raise interest"] rates by 25 basis points to a near 15-year high of 4.60% on Tuesday, expected to be the final rate increase in the tightening cycle. Elsewhere, offshore yuan weakened to 6.7235 per dollar after Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping's [USN:L1N45H0FW TEXT:"three-day summit"] did not yield any big public breakthroughs on a host of contentious issues.

item.title: Rio Tinto commissions carbon-capture trial at China's Shougang steel plant
item.description: Mining major Rio Tinto , said on Monday it had commissioned a trial facility to capture carbon dioxide from blast-furnace gas at Chinese steelmaker Shougang Group's operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mining major Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) , (RIO.L) said on Monday it had commissioned a trial facility to capture carbon dioxide from blast-furnace gas at Chinese steelmaker Shougang Group's operations. Here are some more details: The facility is designed to capture carbon dioxide contained in blast furnace gas produced during iron-making. The facility, located at Shougang's Jingtang base in China, can process up to 3,000 cubic metres of blast furnace gas per hour and capture up to 10,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide annually. The commissioning of the facility forms part of a memorandum of understanding signed in 2022 by Rio Tinto and Shougang to research and develop technologies that could help reduce carbon emissions across the steel value chain. Shares of Rio Tinto were down 0.5% to A$164.2, as of 0102 GMT, while the broader benchmark index (.AXJO) was up 0.3%.

item.title: Indian rupee, bonds vulnerable to oil pangs on waning Iran diplomacy hopes
item.description: Indian rupee and government bonds are expected to remain vulnerable through a holiday-shortened week, with oil prices elevated, global bond yields at multi-year highs and rising bets on a Reserve Bank of India rate hike next week.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia, Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: Indian rupee and government bonds are expected to remain vulnerable through a holiday-shortened week, with oil prices elevated, global bond yields at multi-year highs and rising bets on a Reserve Bank of India rate hike next week. The rupee closed Friday at 95.8150 per dollar, little changed week on week. Over the weekend, US President Donald Trump said he had [USN:L6N45H06Z TEXT:"rejected"] an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting in the Middle East. Iran, meanwhile, insisted that [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"only diplomacy"] can solve its conflict with the United States Investors will also watch key US economic data due this week, including the September non-farm payrolls report and personal consumption expenditure inflation data for August. These data points, along with remarks from Federal Reserve policymakers, are expected to influence market positioning for further US rate hikes. "A softer payroll print could pull US yields lower and provide some reprieve for several regional currencies, while continued US labor-market resilience and sticky price pressures would reinforce higher-for-longer US rates and keep the USD supported," MUFG said in a note. Traders expect RBI interventions, which helped keep the currency hemmed between 95.50 and 96 last week amid global headwinds, to continue. Data released on Friday showed that India's FX reserves declined nearly $15 billion in the week ended September 15, to $765.9 billion. BONDS Indian government bonds will likely face more selling pressure in the last week of the fiscal year's first half as bets on a hawkish RBI grow, while traders expect the central bank to continue draining surplus liquidity from the banking system. Traders expect the benchmark yield to move into the 7.05% to 7.15% range, with focus also on US yields and oil prices. The benchmark 10-year bond yield posted a sixth consecutive weekly rise after ending Friday five basis points higher for the week at 7.1194%. In six weeks starting August 17, it added 36 bps - the longest rising streak in over a year. The RBI has already sold bonds worth 750 billion rupees ($7.83 billion), and will sell 250 billion rupees of securities on Monday. Deutsche Bank expects liquidity withdrawal to continue through foreign-exchange intervention and said further debt sales and sell/buy swaps remain possible, while a 50-basis-point increase in the cash reserve ratio cannot be ruled out. CRR is the percentage of banks' deposits they are mandated to maintain with the RBI, and it currently stands at 3%. India's banking system liquidity surplus jumped to a record after a much larger-than-expected $133 billion inflow under the RBI's special forex mobilisation scheme. "Going forward, market focus is likely to remain on the absorption of the weekly supply, RBI liquidity operations, the October MPC outcome, crude oil prices and global bond yields," Nuvama said in a note. KEY FACTORS: India ** August industrial output – September 28, Monday (4:00 p.m. IST) ** August fiscal deficit data - September 30, Wednesday (3:30 p.m. IST) ** September HSBC manufacturing PMI – October 1, Thursday (10:30 a.m. IST) U.S. ** September consumer confidence - September 29, Tuesday (7:30 p.m. IST) ** August personal consumption expenditure, core PCE - September 30, Wednesday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** April-June GDP growth final - September 30, Wednesday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** Initial weekly jobless claims for the week to September 26 - October 1, Thursday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** September S&P Global manufacturing PMI final - October 1, Thursday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** September ISM manufacturing PMI - October 1, Thursday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** September non-farm payroll and unemployment rate – October 2, Friday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** August factory orders - October 2, Friday (7:30 p.m. IST)

item.title: 米メタ、ＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」の安全警告強化 脆弱性を発見
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ミューズ」において、利用者の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米メタ、ＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」の安全警告強化　脆弱性を発見 10:30 配信

写真はメタの人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ミューズ」のロゴと、キーボード、ロボットの手のイメージ。9月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２５日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ミューズ」において、利用者の機密性の高い個人情報にアクセスできる可能性のある脆弱性が発見されたため安全性に関する警告をより明確な内容にした。米ＩＴ専門メディアの「ジ・インフォメーション」が２５日報じた。

報道によると、この脆弱性は外部の研究者がメタのバグ報奨金制度を通じて報告したもので、これまで見つかっていなかった。ジ・インフォメーションが確認したメタ社内のインシデント報告書によると、攻撃者がこの脆弱性を通じて利用者専用の仮想マシンへアクセスできる可能性があった。この仮想マシンは、個別に割り当てられたクラウドベースのアカウントで、電子メールや各種ファイルなどのデータが保存されているという。

同報告書によると、メタは当初、この脆弱性を５段階評価のうち上から３番目に深刻なレベルに当たる「ＳＥＶ―２」に分類していた。この分類は通常、重大な影響を及ぼす可能性のある事案に適用される区分だという。

ロイターのコメント要請に対し、メタは現時点で回答していない。

ミューズは今月上旬に公開されたメタの個人向けＡＩエージェントで、買い物や旅行予約、電子メールの送信、決済などの作業を利用者に代わって行うよう設計されている。この数週間でアップルのアプリ配信サービス「App Store」とグーグルの「Google Play」でランキングが急速に上昇。米国とカナダの無料アプリランキングで首位に立った。市場調査会社センサー・タワーの推計によると、公開後２週間のダウンロードは約２８０万件に達した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：隠し撮り・録音の懸念どう払拭、「ポスト・スマホ」狙うＡＩ端末とプライバシー保護 コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 9/28(月) 10:30 ロイター

item.title: Madonna, Sabrina Carpenter and Lisa win at MTV's Video Music Awards
item.description: Madonna and Sabrina Carpenter claimed best collaboration and K-pop superstar Lisa won best pop video as MTV kicked off its annual Video Music Awards on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Richwine
item.content:encoded: Madonna and Sabrina Carpenter claimed best collaboration and K-pop superstar Lisa won best pop video as MTV kicked off its annual Video Music Awards on Sunday. "Bring Your Love" from Madonna and Carpenter earned the VMA collaboration award at the show in downtown Los Angeles. The pair had opened the ceremony with a high-energy performance of the song to the cheering crowd. Madonna, the night's top nominee, said she enjoyed working with Carpenter because their work styles complemented each other. "When I show up late, she shows up early," Madonna said, adding that both share the old-school habit of writing lyrics on pieces of paper. "It's been wonderful working with you, and I love this song," she added. Lisa, a member of the group Blackpink, won the VMA for best pop video for her solo effort "Dream." Sporting a black outfit with large white fringe sleeves, she spoke through tears as she thanked her fans, known as Lillies. "I wouldn't be here without you guys," she said as she held the VMA Moon Person trophy. "Thank you so much for your love and support." Taylor Swift was in attendance and was set to be awarded the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors. Swift has directed videos for many of her hits including "The Fate of Ophelia" and "All Too Well," plus the new single "Patient Zero," which was scheduled to debut during the VMAs telecast. Swift, Madonna and Carpenter were all competing for the ceremony's top honor of video of the year. Madonna was nominated for “Confessions II - The Film," Carpenter for "Tears" and Swift for "Ophelia." Winners in the top categories are selected by fan votes. The ceremony was broadcast live on CBS and MTV and streamed on Paramount+ (PSKY.O) .

item.title: テニス＝チェコ、ビリー・ジーン・キング杯12度目の優勝 ウクライナ下す
item.description: ［深セン（中国） ２７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［深セン（中国）　２７日　ロイター］ - 女子テニスの国別対抗戦、ビリー・ジーン・キング杯は２７日、中国の深センで決勝を行い、チェコがウクライナに勝利して通算１２度目の優勝を果たした。

チェコは第１試合、カロリナ・ムホバがアンヘリナ・カリニナに６─２、６─３で勝利。第２試合では、今年のウィンブルドン選手権女子シングルス決勝でムホバに勝利して優勝したリンダ・ノスコバがエリナ・スビトリナを６─３、７─６で下し、２連勝で優勝を決めた。

チェコは最多１８度の優勝を誇る米国に次ぐ優勝回数。ウクライナは大会初優勝を目指していた。

ムホバは「とても特別なこと。トロフィーを掲げることは私の夢だった。ここにいるチームメートたちと一緒にそれを成し遂げることができて、本当にうれしい。チームをとても誇りに思う。優勝できて最高の締めくくりとなった」と述べた。

item.title: Report: 49ers WR Mike Evans has rib strain, will be evaluated Monday
item.description: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans sustained a rib strain in the team's 36-30 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday, according to an NFL Network report. He will undergo a full evaluation on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans sustained a rib strain in the team's 36-30 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday, according to an NFL Network report. He will undergo a full evaluation on Monday. Evans was slow to get up after Budda Baker hit him on an incomplete pass during the second quarter. He entered the medical tent and headed to the locker room on a cart a few minutes later. The 49ers ruled him out at halftime. "We don't know yet," Shanahan told reporters postgame when asked about Evans. "We couldn't tell if it was a broken rib. We couldn't tell if it was an oblique. Something we'll find out probably more tomorrow." The 49ers (3-0) also lost left tackle Trent Williams (stinger) and linebacker Dre Greenlaw (quad) in the second half but stayed unbeaten on the strength of Brock Purdy's four touchdown passes. One of those throws was to Evans, who had three catches for 34 yards and a touchdown before departing. A six-time Pro-Bowler, Evans signed a three-year, $42.4 million deal with San Francisco in March after spending the first 12 years of his career with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Evans has 12 catches for 137 yards and two touchdowns with the 49ers. For his career, Evans has 878 catches for 13,189 yards and 110 touchdowns. Along with Jerry Rice, he's one of just two players to record 11 straight 1,000-yard receiving seasons. --Field Level Media

item.title: Australia's Ingenia Communities mulls Warburg Pincus' improved buyout offer
item.description: Australia's Ingenia Communities Group said on Monday it was assessing an improved A$2.14 billion ($1.50 billion) buyout offer from private equity firm Warburg Pincus after rejecting two earlier bids, sending its shares sharply higher.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's Ingenia Communities Group (INA.AX) said on Monday it was assessing an improved A$2.14 billion ($1.50 billion) buyout offer from private equity firm Warburg Pincus after rejecting two earlier bids, sending its shares sharply higher. Here are some more details: The latest offer, at A$5.25 per share, is nearly 4% higher than the [USN:L1N45D006 TEXT:"previous"] bid of A$5.05 apiece, or A$2.06 billion, and represents a 16.7% premium to the stock's last close. It is 10.5% higher than the [USN:L6N44Y09H TEXT:"initial"] approach of A$4.75 per share, or A$1.94 billion. Ingenia had rejected the previous two proposals, saying they "substantially" undervalued the firm. In the current offer, Warburg Pincus retained the earlier condition that Ingenia abandon its planned $711-million acquisition of master-planned communities developer Peet (PPC.AX) , a deal Ingenia sees as central to its strategy. Ingenia said its board was assessing the revised proposal and had not yet formed a view on the offer or its conditions. The board did not make any recommendation to shareholders with respect to the offer. Ingenia shares rose as much as 7.1% to hit their highest level since late January. The stock has climbed nearly 30% since early September when the firm first said it had been approached with a buyout offer. ($1 = 1.4261 Australian dollars)

item.title: イスラエル首相がＵＡＥ訪問か、ハマス奇襲事前警告報道の中
item.description: [２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２７日 ロイター] - イスラエル政府高官は、ネタニヤフ首相が２７日にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビを訪問し、ムハンマド大統領と会談したとロイターに明らかにした。

イスラエル首相府とＵＡＥ外務省は現時点でコメントしていない。

イスラエル紙ハーレツは今月、イスラム組織ハマスによる２０２３年１０月７日のイスラエル奇襲について、ムハンマド氏が１週間半前に、ハマスが大規模な作戦を計画しているとネタニヤフ氏に警告していたと報じた。同紙によると、この警告はイスラエルの情報機関や軍には伝えられなかったという。

ネタニヤフ氏は報道を否定し、同紙に対する法的措置を示唆している。総選挙を控え、野党はハマスの攻撃に先立つ安全保障上の失態についてネタニヤフ氏に責任があると批判しており、同氏は再選に向けて厳しい選挙戦を強いられている。

ＵＡＥはハーレツの報道についてコメントを控えているが、イスラエルとは２０２０年の国交樹立以来「開かれた直接的な意思疎通のルート」を維持していると述べている。

item.title: 仏極右「国民連合」、上院で初の会派結成へ 次期大統領選に弾み
item.description: [パリ ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２７日 ロイター] - フランスの極右指導者らは、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」と右派の同盟勢力が２７日に実施された上院議員の間接選挙で独自会派を結成するのに十分な議席を獲得したと明らかにした。

ＲＮが上院会派結成に必要な１０議席を確保したのは初めて。同党は、２０２７年大統領選に向け準備を進めており、世論調査では第１回投票で首位に立つ見通しとなっている。

次期大統領選に立候補しているＲＮのマリーヌ・ルペン党首は「結果はわれわれの予想を上回った」とＸに投稿した。

フランスでは極右政党の候補が大統領の座に就いたことはこれまでない。

２７日の選挙では、上院の定数３４８議席中１７８議席が改選対象となったが、ＲＮは獲得議席数を明らかにしていない。

上院議員は、国民議会（下院）の議員と地方の公選代表者によって選ばれる。

会派の代表は、採決を要求できるなどの権限を持つ。

item.title: オープンＡＩとアンソロピックのＣＥＯに証言要請、豪議会 ＡＩ巡る調査で
item.description: [シドニー ２７日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が豪上...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩとアンソロピックのＣＥＯに証言要請、豪議会　ＡＩ巡る調査で 10:04 配信

写真はオープンＡＩとアンソロピックのロゴと、ロボットの手のイメージ。6月11日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[シドニー ２７日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が豪上院のＡＩに関する調査で証言を求められたことが２７日、明らかになった。

オープンＡＩが開発したＡＩエージェントが今年６月に豪政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルに不正アクセスしていたことが判明している。米国外でＡＩエージェントが外部システムにアクセスした事例として注目されている。

調査を主導する緑の党のサラ・ハンソン・ヤング上院議員の広報担当者によると、オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯとアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイＣＥＯに、書面で証言要請が送付された。公聴会は１０月１日に首都キャンベラで開かれる予定だ。

ハンソン・ヤング氏は声明で、「オープンＡＩによる豪政府サイトへのハッキングを巡り、サム・アルトマン氏が答えるべき重大な問題がある」と表明。「（アルトマン氏とアモデイ氏は）出席して上院の質問に向き合い、この業界に対する効果的で持続的な規制の在り方について率直な議論を行わなければならない」と述べた。

item.title: Vikings star WR Justin Jefferson knocked out early with ankle injury
item.description: The Minnesota Vikings played most of their Week 3 road victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers without star wide receiver Justin Jefferson, who sustained a left ankle injury during the first quarter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Minnesota Vikings played most of their Week 3 road victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers without star wide receiver Justin Jefferson, who sustained a left ankle injury during the first quarter. The two-time first-team All-Pro appeared to hurt the ankle on a 10-yard reception at the tail end of Minnesota's first possession. He was able to leave the field on his own and spent some of the second quarter on the Vikings' sideline, wearing his helmet, before retreating to the locker room. "He tried to work through it, got close (to returning) a couple times. Ended up being ruled out," Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said after the 23-16 victory. "We'll evaluate him more (Monday)." Jefferson, who finished the game with two catches for 32 yards, played in all 17 games for Minnesota in 2024 and 2025. He missed seven games in 2023 with a right hamstring injury. Through three weeks, Jefferson has collected 13 receptions for 179 yards and two touchdowns. His departure came on the same day that quarterback Kyler Murray returned to action from a concussion sustained in Week 1. Also for the Vikings, tight end Josh Oliver (bicep) and cornerback Charles Demmings (hamstring) were knocked out of the game and will be evaluated further, per O'Connell. --Field Level Media

item.title: テニス＝レーバー杯、欧州選抜が最多6度目の優勝 世界選抜に快勝
item.description: ［ロンドン ２７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ロンドン　２７日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの欧州選抜と世界選抜による対抗戦、レーバー・カップ（杯）は２７日、最終日を行い、欧州選抜が世界選抜を１３─５で下し、史上最多を更新する６度目の優勝を果たした。

最終日を７─５のリードで迎えた欧州選抜は、最初のダブルスでフラビオ・コボリ（イタリア）、ヤクブ・メンシク（チェコ）組がテーラー・フリッツ（米国）、アレックス・デミノー（オーストラリア）組を７─５、６─３で下し、１０─５とした。

続くシングルスでは世界ランキング２位のアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）がラーナー・ティエン（米国）に７─６、６─３でストレート勝ち。欧州選抜に３ポイントをもたらし、優勝を決めた。

ズベレフが欧州選抜の優勝を決めるポイントを挙げたのは４度目。２０１８年のシカゴ、１９年のジュネーブでも決勝点を挙げ、２１年のボストンではダブルスで優勝を決めていた。

ズベレフは「自分が決められてうれしい。われわれは素晴らしいチームで、一体感もチーム一丸となった取り組みも素晴らしかった。優勝できて本当にうれしい」と話した。

大会は３日間で行われ、各試合の勝利で初日は１ポイント、２日目は２ポイント、最終日は３ポイントを獲得し、先に１３ポイントに到達したチームが優勝する。欧州選抜は１７、１８、１９、２１、２４年に続く６度目の優勝。世界選抜は２２、２３、２５年に優勝している。

item.title: China's space diplomacy lifts Pakistani astronaut toward orbit
item.description: Two Pakistani pilots are memorising Mandarin, spinning in centrifuge drills and learning to eat, sleep and repair equipment while weightless as a decision nears on which one will become the first foreign astronaut aboard China's Tiangong space station.
item.dc:creator: Saad Sayeed, Ariba Shahid
item.content:encoded: Two Pakistani pilots are memorising Mandarin, spinning in centrifuge drills and learning to eat, sleep and repair equipment while weightless as a decision nears on which one will become the first foreign astronaut aboard China's Tiangong space station. The voyage into space would be a first for the South Asian nation. It is part of broader cooperation with Beijing that straddles the Belt and Road Initiative and has produced Chinese-launched Pakistani satellites, a joint satellite-navigation system and a Pakistani-built rover due to fly on China's Chang'e 8 [USN:L8N40L0F6 TEXT:"lunar mission"] around 2028. Pilots Zeeshan Ali and Khurram Daud have spent months training at the China Astronaut Research and Training Center in Beijing for a mission that was conceived by the two countries in 2019, said Amer Gilani, who oversees human spaceflight cooperation at Pakistan's space agency, SUPARCO. China has not said which of the two will fly or when, but Gilani said a final astronaut selection decision is expected in mid-to-late October. Whoever is chosen will not return to Pakistan before launch, setting off into space directly from training in China and returning home after a recovery period following the return to Earth, Gilani told Reuters in an interview. Training includes intensive Chinese-language instruction, learning spacecraft systems, and adapting to both the microgravity of orbit and the g-forces of liftoff, he added. The two men beat out roughly 20 finalists culled from an initial Pakistani pool of pilots and scientists, screened for medical fitness, psychological resilience and, according to SUPARCO's director of artificial intelligence Uzair Ansari, a tolerance for g-forces that few scientists possess. "You cannot easily find scientists who are familiar with travelling and facing high-level g-forces," he said, explaining this is why the two men with backgrounds in high-speed flying were chosen. The details shared by Gilani and Ansari are the first insight provided by SUPARCO to foreign media since the pilots were selected and deployed to China. China's space agency did not respond to a request for comment about the selection process. MODEST PAYLOAD Once in space, the chosen pilot will carry the title of "payload specialist", which is astronaut-speak for someone whose job in orbit is running Pakistan's science experiments rather than flying the ship, Ansari said. Of more than 300 proposals SUPARCO fielded from universities in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad after a year-long campaign, Gilani said Chinese institutes picked four for this flight: biotechnology experiments that will help combat food insecurity and climate change. Every experiment is built and pre-tested in SUPARCO's own labs before Chinese engineers sign off — a rare case, Ansari said, where Pakistani technology gets validated on an international platform. The scientific payload is modest next to a station that has already hosted more than 180 experiments and produced over 500 research papers and 150 patents, Ansari added. Tiangong's three modules — Tianhe, Wentian and Mengtian — weigh about 77 metric tons combined and house roughly 14 experiment racks spanning life sciences, materials, fluid physics, combustion and radiation exposure, Gilani said, including some mounted outside the station and exposed directly to space for materials and biotechnology payloads. RELIANCE ON BEIJING The astronaut will fly aboard a Chinese-built spacecraft, launched from a Chinese site, trained by Chinese instructors and communicating in Mandarin in orbit. Pakistan has no independent launch vehicle or crewed spacecraft of its own, and the stay itself will be about a week, a fraction of the roughly six-month rotations of career Chinese crew members. The Pakistani astronaut is due to return with two members of a Chinese crew that arrived at the space station in May because the third member is expected to [USN:L4N41X0RK TEXT:"stay for a year"] to enable the study of long-duration human physiology in space. Since Yuri Gagarin's 1961 first flight, citizens of about 50 countries have flown in space, but only three nations — Russia, the US, and China — have launched their own crewed spacecraft. China's invitation to Pakistan is the first time it will transport a foreign astronaut. Asked whether Islamabad had secured any promise to send an astronaut to the moon under the same partnership, Gilani said "there is no official commitment or discussion on this matter," adding that what comes next will depend on how "our maiden mission" turns out. The Pakistani-built lunar rover that is due to fly on China's Chang'e 8 lunar mission around 2028 is a separate strand of that cooperation: it will use AI-based stereo imaging to detect obstacles, judge depth and plan its own path across the lunar surface, since Earth-based controllers cannot guide it in real time, Ansari said. Still, Ansari was clear the mission is a "once-in-a-lifetime opportunity" for Pakistani scientists.

item.title: 基調物価2％定着に向けた政策運営に「シフトしつつある」＝日銀7月会合
item.description:
Takahiko Wada
［東京 ２８日 ロイター］ - 日銀が７月に開いた金融政策決定会合では、基調的な物価上...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
基調物価2％定着に向けた政策運営に「シフトしつつある」＝日銀7月会合 10:01 配信

写真は日銀本店と日本の国旗。9月18日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

［東京　２８日　ロイター］ - 日銀が７月に開いた金融政策決定会合では、基調的な物価上昇率が２％に近づく中、多くの委員が「基調的な物価上昇率を２％程度に定着させていくことを目指して政策判断を行う方向に徐々にシフトしつつあり、その下での政策運営のあり方について、より丁寧なコミュニケーションが必要」との認識を示していたことが明らかになった。委員からは、利上げペースの加速を支持する意見が相次いだ。

日銀が２８日に７月の決定会合の議事要旨を公表した。同会合では賛成多数で政策金利を１％で据え置いたが、９月１７―１８日の決定会合では１．２５％への追加利上げを決めた。

item.title: 仏大統領選控え、国債危機回避に万全尽くす必要＝仏中銀総裁
item.description: [パリ ２５日 ロイター] - フランス銀行（中央銀行）のムーラン総裁は２５日、来年の大統領選挙に向けて同国は国債危...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏大統領選控え、国債危機回避に万全尽くす必要＝仏中銀総裁 10:00 配信

フランス銀行（中央銀行）のムーラン総裁。6月9日、パリで撮影。 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ２５日 ロイター] - フランス銀行（中央銀行）のムーラン総裁は２５日、来年の大統領選挙に向けて同国は国債危機の回避に万全を尽くす必要があり、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が救済に出てくると期待するのは誤りだと述べた。議会上院メディア「ピュブリック・セナ」のインタビューに答えた。

フランスの１０年物国債利回り は４．７％と、２００８年の世界金融危機以来の高水準に急騰している。同国の財政、政局不透明感への懸念から、投資家がより高いプレミアムを要求した格好だ。

ムーラン氏は、大統領選前に国債危機が起こるのを防ぐためにこそ「歳出削減を伴い、財政赤字を削減傾向に戻す予算」が必要だと強調した。政府は１０月１日に２０２７年予算案を議会に提出し、数週間にわたる審議が始まる予定だ。

同氏は、政府は問題なく国債市場で資金調達ができているとしながらも、債務利払い費の増加が財政を「段階的に圧迫する」リスクがあると警告。資金調達に困難が生じた場合にはＥＣＢが介入できるかとの質問に対しては、そうした考えに頼ろうとすることは「誤った論理」を反映していると述べた。

ムーラン氏は、金融セクターが現在「堅固で、資本も十分」だとし、状況は２００８年とは異なるとも語った。

item.title: Bank of Japan debated need for faster rate hikes, July minutes show
item.description: Many Bank of Japan policymakers saw the need to focus on mounting inflation risks, with some calling for faster interest rate increases, minutes of their July meeting showed, cementing the case for further hikes to still-low borrowing costs.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: Many Bank of Japan policymakers saw the need to focus on mounting inflation risks, with some calling for faster interest rate increases, minutes of their July meeting showed, cementing the case for further hikes to still-low borrowing costs. After raising interest rates in June, the central bank [USN:L1N43X04X TEXT:"paused"] in July before pushing its policy rate to a 31-year high of 1.25% [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"this month"], as the Middle East war and a stubbornly weak yen lifted prices of fuel and raw material imports. Given mounting inflation risks, many in the nine-member board said the BOJ was gradually shifting its policy focus towards anchoring underlying inflation around its 2% target, rather than pushing up prices, the minutes showed on Monday. "Markets appeared to be expecting the BOJ to raise interest rates with intervals of about six months. But the pace of rate hikes could be faster than such market expectations, given underlying inflation had approached 2% and the greater need to focus on upside price risks," one member was quoted as saying. A different member said the BOJ must pay particular attention to upside price risks and "adjust its policy rate nimbly," the minutes showed. The BOJ must speed up rate hikes as the risk of waiting was no longer marginal, a third member was quoted as saying, warning that the economy will face huge damage if inflation risks materialise. MORE HIKES EYED At the [USN:L1N43X04X TEXT:"July 30-31 policy meeting"], the BOJ kept interest rates steady at 1%, but it warned that underlying inflation could exceed its target and said future policy discussions would focus on upside price risks. The July minutes indicated growing concern within the board of mounting inflation risks, with some members projecting rising wholesale prices spreading to broader-based inflation. Many members said long-term inflation expectations were heightening for both households and companies. One said the BOJ must scrutinise whether such expectations would stabilise around 2%, as it sought to anchor underlying inflation at its target. With the BOJ having raised rates in June and September, many analysts see a growing chance it will keep hiking at shorter intervals than the roughly twice-a-year pace of 2024 and 2025. The BOJ faces greater pressure to raise rates than other major central banks, as its policy rate remains near the bottom of the estimated 1.1% to 2.5% range of Japan's nominal neutral rate — or the level that neither cools nor overheats growth. "Even if the precise level of neutral could not be determined, the BOJ must raise its policy rate, which remains below the lower bound of the broadly estimated neutral rate range, to set the foundations of policy normalisation and ensure it can nimbly adjust policy," the July minutes quoted one member as saying. A key gauge of Japan's service-sector inflation rose in August at the fastest annual pace in more than two years, data showed on [USN:L4N45K00K TEXT:"Monday"], highlighting mounting price pressures. Many analysts expect the BOJ to revise up its inflation forecasts in a quarterly report due at its next policy meeting on October 29-30. The analysts predict the central bank will hike again as soon as October or December. Expectations of further rate hikes pushed the benchmark 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) yield to 3.115% on [USN:L4N45H01K TEXT:"Friday"], a level last seen in August 1996.

item.title: 【日本市況】円は157円後半に下落、債券売り－日経平均6万7000円回復
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 28日の日本市場では円が対ドルで157円台後半に下落。アジア時間帯の取引で原油価格や米国の長期金利が上昇しており、インフレの高止まりを見込むがドル買いが優勢だ。債券も売りが優勢な半面、AI関連銘柄中心に上昇する株式は日経平均株価が約1カ月半ぶりに一時6万7000円を回復した。

ホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けた米国とイランの交渉進展期待で前週末の国際原油市況は下落していたものの、アジア時間28日の取引では再び上昇。イランが譲歩しない姿勢を堅持し、航行再開への懸念が再燃している。北海ブレント原油は1バレル＝106ドルを挟んで推移する。

原油高を受けたインフレの高止まりで米連邦準備制度理事会が追加利上げを行うとの見方も根強く、米10年国債利回りもアジア時間の取引で5.2%台に上昇。前週末は5.16%に低下していた。

円は対ドルで157円台後半に下落。トランプ氏がイランのホルムズ海峡開放提案を拒否したほか、フーシ派が週末にサウジアラビアの首都リヤドを再び攻撃したことなどを受け、ドルの買い戻しが優勢となっている。

日本銀行が28日朝に公表した7月30・31日に開いた金融政策決定会合の議事要旨では、1人の委員が緩和度合いの「調整をペースアップする必要がある」と主張したことが分かったが、円相場への影響は限定的だ。

もっとも、片山さつき財務相が日本時間25日夜にベッセント米財務長官と電話会談を行い、円の過小評価は問題だとの認識を再確認したことは円を下支えしている。

SBI FXトレードの上田真理人社長は、日米当局の円安を抑えようとする力が意外に強く、ドル・円が159円に近づけば「一層介入警戒感が強まるだろう」と指摘。日本の単独介入も「場合によってはある」が、「円をどんどん買うような材料はない」とも話している。

債券は下落（金利は上昇）。長期国債先物は一時前週末比24銭安の124円11銭まで下げ、新発10年国債利回りは2ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp=0.01%）高い3.095%に上昇した。

item.title: ＥＵのＥＶトラック、購入・運用コストがディーゼル車より安価に＝報告書
item.description: [ストックホルム ２８日 ロイター] - 環境保護団体トランスポート・アンド・エンバイロメント（Ｔ＆Ｅ）が２８日発表した...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＵのＥＶトラック、購入・運用コストがディーゼル車より安価に＝報告書 9:56 配信

ボルボの電気セミトラック。8月、米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチで撮影。 REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ストックホルム ２８日 ロイター] - 環境保護団体トランスポート・アンド・エンバイロメント（Ｔ＆Ｅ）が２８日発表した報告書によると、中東紛争に起因するディーゼル価格の高騰を背景に、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の主要６市場で電動トラックの購入・運用コストがディーゼルモデルよりも安くなっている。これらの市場はＥＵ全体の新車トラック販売台数のほぼ半分を占めている。

• Ｔ＆Ｅの分析で、２０２６年に購入された電動トラックはディーゼル車と比較して、５年間でオランダでは最大１０万ユーロ（１１万３９１０ドル）、ドイツでは８万５０００ユーロ、デンマークでは６万９０００ユーロのコスト削減効果をもたらすことが判明した。

• これらの市場では、事業者は初期の価格差を約２年で回収できる。

• 欧州における電動トラックへの移行は、購入価格の高さと、充電インフラが不十分なことが原因で伸び悩んでいる。

• Ｔ＆ＥはＥＵ９カ国における総所有コストを調査。それによると、ＥＵの大型トラック登録台数の４６％を占めるオランダ、ドイツ、デンマーク、スウェーデン、フランス、ベルギーの各市場で、電動トラックの運用コストは既にディーゼル車よりも安くなっている。

• ロイターは今年に入って、ダイムラー・トラック 、ボルボ・グループ 、トラトン傘下のスカニアといった欧州トラックメーカー各社が、低コストの中国製競合車の参入に備えているとし、一部の中国製電動トラックの価格は同等の欧州製モデルより３０％程度安くなると見込まれると報じている。

• Ｔ＆Ｅは、中国製電動トラックの価格が約２１万ユーロであるのに対し、同等の欧州製モデルは２６万５０００ユーロと推計している。

• ドイツでは中国製の電動トラックを選択すると、事業者は５年間でさらに３万４０００ユーロのコスト削減が可能となると試算している。

item.title: Momenta and Stellantis' China JV with Dongfeng to co-develop intelligent driving technology
item.description: Momenta , a Chinese maker of autonomous-driving software, has agreed to work with a Stellantis joint venture to develop advanced driver-assistance technology, it said on Monday, adding Jeep and Peugeot to its growing roster of global brands.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Momenta (6880.HK) , a Chinese maker of autonomous-driving software, has agreed to work with a Stellantis (STLAM.MI) joint venture to develop advanced driver-assistance technology, it said on Monday, adding Jeep and Peugeot to its growing roster of global brands. In a statement, Momenta said it signed a global strategic partnership on Thursday to work with Dongfeng Stellantis Automotive Technology (Wuhan) and the two Stellantis brands on intelligent driving technology. The two companies will jointly develop an advanced intelligent driving assistance system for new mass-produced Peugeot and Jeep models. The new technology will be deployed in China, Europe and other markets, helping drive the global smart mobility push of Stellantis' mainstream brands. Peugeot and Jeep will work with Momenta on product definition and co-development to create advanced driving assistance features aligned with their brand identities. Stellantis formed the joint venture with Dongfeng in August to better compete against Chinese rivals. The deal extends Momenta's push beyond its mainstay customers of German premium automakers. Momenta's driver-assistance software has been used on the road in more than 1.2 million vehicles.

item.title: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield dislocates thumb vs. Vikings
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield sustained a dislocated right thumb late in Sunday's 23-16 home loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield sustained a dislocated right thumb late in Sunday's 23-16 home loss to the Minnesota Vikings. Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles announced the extent of the injury after the contest and said Mayfield will undergo an MRI exam on Monday. Bowles said X-rays didn't show a fracture. Mayfield, who recently received a three-year, $165 million extension, was injured on a fourth-and-13 play in which he was intercepted by Minnesota's Andrew Van Ginkel with 1:39 left in the contest. Mayfield was hit in the thumb by rushing Blake Cashman and went down in obvious pain, grabbed his bloody thumb and was heard yelling. After later walking off the field, he slammed his helmet to the ground while walking from the bench area to the locker room. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels is Tampa Bay's only other quarterback on the 53-man roster and he entered with 33 seconds left for the team's final series. He didn't complete any of his three passes, including an interception by Minnesota's Isaiah Rodgers on the final-play "Hail Mary" throw. He also scrambled once for 9 yards. Bowles indicated Daniels would be the starting quarterback next Sunday against the visiting Green Bay Packers, pending developments involving Mayfield. Easton Stick is on the Buccaneers' practice squad. He went 0-4 as a starter for the Los Angeles Chargers in 2023 when Justin Herbert was injured. Mayfield declined to speak with reporters after the contest. Mayfield completed 17 of 34 passes for 217 yards, one touchdown and one interception for Tampa Bay (0-3) before being injured. The TD throw was the 199th of his NFL career. Mayfield, 31, is in his fourth season with the Buccaneers and ninth overall. He was a Pro Bowl selection his first two seasons with Tampa Bay. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＳＫハイニックス米子会社、来年にもＩＰＯか 評価額最大1500億ドル
item.description:
Milana Vinn Echo Wang
[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 韓国半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスの米...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＳＫハイニックス米子会社、来年にもＩＰＯか　評価額最大1500億ドル 9:51 配信

2024年10月、ソウルで開催された展示会に並べられたSKハイニックスの製品。 REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

Milana Vinn　Echo Wang

[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 韓国半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスの米子会社ソリダイムが、早ければ２０２７年にも新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を実施する方向で検討していることが分かった。評価額は最大１５００億ドルに達する可能性があるという。事情に詳しい関係者３人が明らかにした。実現すれば、半導体業界で過去最大級のＩＰＯの一つとなる。

関係者によると、ソリダイムは今週、ＩＰＯの主幹事を巡って競合する複数の投資銀行とピッチミーティングを開いた。「ベイクオフ」と呼ばれるこのプロセスは、ＩＰＯに向けた具体的な一歩となる。

関係者によれば、同社はＩＰＯで１５０億ドルを調達する可能性がある。案件の規模や時期など計画はなお初期段階にあり、市場環境次第で変わる可能性があるとしている。

ソリダイムはコメントを控えた。ＳＫハイニックスは声明で「ソリダイムは事業競争力を強化するためのさまざまな選択肢を検討しているが、現時点で具体的な計画は決まっていない」と述べた。

最大１５００億ドルの評価額は、近年の半導体ＩＰＯを大幅に上回る規模となる。英半導体設計大手アーム・ホールディングスは２３年ＩＰＯ時の評価額が約５４０億ドル、米セレブラス・システムズは２６年ＩＰＯ時の希薄化後ベースの評価額が約５６０億ドルだった。

ソリダイムはカリフォルニア州に拠点を置き、ＮＡＮＤ型フラッシュメモリーおよびソリッドステートドライブ（ＳＳＤ）を手がける。

item.title: Reports: South Carolina's Dylan Stewart suspended indefinitely
item.description: South Carolina coach Shane Beamer announced Sunday that junior defensive end Dylan Stewart will not play next week against Kentucky and has been suspended indefinitely.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Carolina coach Shane Beamer announced Sunday that junior defensive end Dylan Stewart will not play next week against Kentucky and has been suspended indefinitely. A decision regarding Stewart's future with the Gamecocks could come within the next couple of days, Beamer added. Stewart punched Alabama tight end Josh Ford in the helmet on Saturday during South Carolina's 49-18 loss to the Crimson Tide and shouted at coaches when he was subbed out of the game. At one point, Stewart walked away while Beamer was speaking to him. Beamer ran back to Stewart and held his right arm as they walked down the sideline. "I saw the play that he got the penalty on. I didn't see it until just now, and that's unacceptable," Beamer told reporters Saturday. "That's not how we do things around here. I'm embarrassed to see that because that's not what we're about." In two-plus seasons at South Carolina, Stewart has totaled 57 tackles, 23.5 tackles for loss and 11 sacks. A back injury kept him on the sideline this year until he made his debut Sept. 19 against Mississippi State. The Gamecocks (2-2, 0-2 SEC) go for their first conference win Saturday at home against the No. 24 Wildcats. --Field Level Media

item.title: Stocks cautious in Asia as oil gains, yields rise
item.description: Share markets made a cautious start on Monday as oil prices popped higher again amid doubts the United States and Iran will reach a truce anytime soon, keeping bonds under pressure ahead of a week packed with economic news.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Cole
item.content:encoded: Share markets made a cautious start on Monday as oil prices popped higher again amid doubts the [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"United States and Iran"] will reach a truce anytime soon, keeping bonds under pressure ahead of a week packed with economic news. Over the weekend, US President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, claiming Tehran was desperate to make a deal. Trump said talks would continue this week, though Iran shows no sign of watering down its proposals. Brent futures quickly rose 1.6% to $106.00 a barrel, bringing gains so far this month to 17%, while US crude futures added 1.1% to $93.47 a barrel. A dearth of refining capacity has in turn lifted [USN:L1N45H0Q0 TEXT:"diesel"] prices to all-time highs far above crude, raising the risk that inflation will become embedded in pricing and wage decisions. Central banks have responded with a round of rate hikes, with the [USN:L4N45F18Y TEXT:"Reserve Bank of Australia"] likely to be the next to tighten when it meets on Tuesday. Markets now imply a 66% chance the Federal Reserve will hike for a second straight meeting in October, with around 90 basis points of tightening priced out to late next year. At the same time, a run of strong [USN:L1N45H0BU TEXT:"US economic data"] has supported expectations for corporate earnings even as bond yields surge, so underpinning equities. The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow measure is forecasting growth of a racy 5.0% for this quarter. Activity has also proven upbeat in Asia and Europe, thanks in part to the boom in AI investment. "The global expansion appears to have entered a phase of broad-based strength rarely seen over the past two decades," said Bruce Kasman, chief economist at JPMorgan. "Amidst strong growth and firming perceptions of resilience to high energy prices, it is no surprise that rates are moving higher while equity prices remain close to record levels," he added. "What is most notable about recent market moves is their extension of higher policy rates well beyond the coming year." BONDS FEAR HIGHER FOR LONGER Japan's Nikkei (.N225) gained 0.8%, while South Korean stocks (.KS11) dipped 0.6%. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) eased 0.2%. In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures firmed 0.4%, while DAX futures gained 0.3% and FTSE futures added 0.2%. On Wall Street, S&P 500 futures fell 0.2%, while Nasdaq futures were flat. Yields on 30-year Treasuries nudged up to 5.5185%, near their highest since 2004, having climbed 27 basis points just this month. Two-year yields have shot up 55 basis points this month in anticipation of Fed hikes. Mark Cabana, a rate strategist at Bank of America, sees further room for bonds to sell off as markets price higher Fed Funds. "The repricing may not stop until there's clear evidence that financial conditions have become sufficiently restrictive," he warned. The spike in yields raises borrowing costs globally just as tech firms are borrowing billions to fund their AI expansion, while also lifting the discount applied to company earnings. The US data calendar is packed with readings on inflation, GDP, manufacturing and jobs. The key September payrolls report on Friday is forecast to show a gain of 85,000 while the unemployment rate is expected to hold at 4.1%, with some chance of a dip to 4.0%. The recent spate of upbeat figures has boosted the dollar index to two-month peaks at 101.39. The euro was down at $1.1380 , having lost 2.0% so far this month. The dollar edged up to 157.53 yen , after dipping on Friday when Japan's Finance Minister [USN:L1N45H01I TEXT:"Satsuki Katayama"] said Trump had voiced concerns about yen weakness. Sterling was just above three-month lows at $1.3228 , having been helped somewhat by hawkish comments on rates from [USN:L8N45H0H9 TEXT:"Bank of England Governor"] Andrew Bailey. In commodity markets, non-interest-bearing gold was off 0.5% at $4,262 an ounce , having fallen more than 4% this month as yields shot higher.

item.title: ＦＢＩ職員の流出情報、精神科などの医療記録も ハッカー集団主張
item.description:
AJ Vicens Raphael Satter
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
AJ Vicens　Raphael Satter

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 世界の大手企業などにサイバー攻撃を仕掛けてきたハッカー集団「シャイニーハンターズ」がこのほど盗み出した米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）職員のデータに、精神科診療や健康診断の記録など機微な情報が含まれていることが、同集団の説明とロイターが確認した文書で分かった。

同集団は２２日、ＦＢＩ職員の採用サイトに侵入し、２─３テラバイト分のデータを盗んだと主張。中国のスパイやロシア諜報機関、麻薬カルテルなどに対する機微な業務内容を含む職員情報を入手したとされる。ＦＢＩは「積極的に調査している」と述べた。

ロイターは入手した６件ほどのファイルの一部について、社会保障番号を信用情報機関のデータと照合するなどの方法で真正性を部分的に確認した。文書には採用予定者の「職務適性検査」や、高校時代に「うつ症状」を示していたとの記載、心電図結果などが含まれていた。

元ＦＢＩ職員で、サイバーセキュリティー会社「ネクサシュアＡＩ」創業者のエリック・オニール氏は、医療データが含まれていることは、今回のハッキングは、米国人数百万人分の機密情報が流出した２０１５年の米人事管理局侵入事件と同規模に迫っている兆候だと指摘した。

ＦＢＩは記録についてコメントを控えている。

item.title: Lula sugere órgão colegiado para avaliar escolha de ministros do STF
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defendeu neste domingo que a escolha de ministros para o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) seja submetida a um órgão colegiado que avalize os nomes antes que sejam enviados ao Senado, na esteira de uma das mais graves crises enfrentadas pela Suprema Corte do país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defendeu neste domingo que a escolha de ministros para o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) seja submetida a um órgão colegiado que avalize os nomes antes que sejam enviados ao Senado, na esteira de uma das mais graves crises enfrentadas pela Suprema Corte do país. Lula já havia se posicionado a favor de uma reforma do Poder Judiciário e defendido critérios objetivos para a escolhas de integrantes do STF. Mas, em entrevista ao programa Canal Livre, da Band, veiculada neste domingo, mencionou a sugestão de criar um conselho de representantes que possa avaliar as indicações. Lula ponderou, no entanto, que ainda quer conversar com integrantes do governo e juristas antes de tomar qualquer decisão. “Acho que tem que mudar o critério, eu acho que não pode ser só o presidente que indique. Acho que nós temos que criar um critério de como envolver a sociedade civil para que a gente indique alguém que não seja só da vontade do presidente ou da OAB. Que seja alguém que passe por um crivo de um colegiado, que a gente vai ter que pensar como criar, para que aquela pessoa não seja mais um cara indicado pelo presidente, então tem que votar com o presidente. Não é assim que funciona", disse Lula, na entrevista. O STF atravessa uma crise alimentada por denúncias de irregularidades contra diversos ministros, suspeitos de envolvimento no esquema de fraude bilionária do banco Master.

item.title: ＦＴＣ委員長、ＡＩ開発者の責任示唆 エージェント「暴走」で
item.description:
Jody Godoy
[オースティン ２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）のファーガソン委員長は２５日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＴＣ委員長、ＡＩ開発者の責任示唆　エージェント「暴走」で 9:41 配信

米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）のファーガソン委員長。9月25日、米テキサス州オースティンで撮影。 REUTERS/Kaylee Greenlee

Jody Godoy

[オースティン ２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）のファーガソン委員長は２５日、ＡＩ（人工知能）エージェントについて「独自の意思や欲求」を持って「暴走する」自律的な行為主体と表現することに異を唱え、エージェントに指示を出す開発者側が被害の責任を負うべきとの考えを示唆した。

ロイター主催の「モメンタムＡＩオースティン」イベントで、「私は委員長職にある限り、こうしたツールを擬人化する動きに抵抗し続けるつもりだ」と発言した。

同氏の発言は、ＡＩエージェントが企業や政府のデータに不正アクセスする事例が増える中、トランプ政権が取り得る対応の方向性を示すものと言える。

こうした不正アクセス例では、ＡＩ企業は自社システムが人間の制御を超えて動作したと説明することがあるが、同氏によると、その後の検証では、システムは与えられた指示を実行していたことが判明しているという。

同氏は、米国はＡＩについても既存の法的手段を活用すべきだと主張。データ侵害の開示を怠った企業に対して措置を取るＦＴＣの権限は、ＡＩ開発者にも適用可能との見解を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：隠し撮り・録音の懸念どう払拭、「ポスト・スマホ」狙うＡＩ端末とプライバシー保護 コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 9/28(月) 9:41 ロイター

item.title: Papa Leão se compromete a acabar com abusos em encontro com vítimas na França
item.description: O papa Leão reafirmou seu compromisso de acabar com os abusos cometidos por padres na Igreja Católica durante um encontro em Lourdes com sete sobreviventes de abusos cometidos por clérigos franceses, informou o Vaticano neste domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão reafirmou seu compromisso de acabar com os abusos cometidos por padres na Igreja Católica durante um encontro em Lourdes com sete sobreviventes de abusos cometidos por clérigos franceses, informou o Vaticano neste domingo. O papa “agradeceu a eles por seus dolorosos depoimentos e reafirmou seu compromisso de garantir que o dano que sofreram não se repita com outras pessoas”, disse um comunicado. Leão está em uma visita relâmpago de quatro dias a três cidades na França. Bispos locais esperam que sua visita ajude a restaurar a reputação da Igreja após um relatório devastador de 2021 sobre abusos contra crianças cometidos por padres causar comoção em todo o país.

item.title: ウクライナ支援、仏独選挙で懐疑派勝利でも揺るがず 北・東欧諸国が明言
item.description:
John Irish Tom Balmforth
[国連 ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
John Irish　Tom Balmforth

[国連 ２５日 ロイター] - フランスやドイツでウクライナ支援に懐疑的な政党が選挙で勝利しても、欧州連合（ＥＵ）によるウクライナ支援が大きく揺らぐことはない－－。北欧や東欧の首脳・外相が相次いでこうした見方を示した。加盟国の政治情勢が変化しても、ＥＵにはそれを乗り越えるだけの強靱性があるとしている。

ロイターの取材に応じたこれらの人々は、欧州各国の選挙情勢が支援の先行きにリスクをもたらしていることを認める一方、軍事面や資金面で不足を抱えたウクライナが厳しい冬を迎える中でも、支援を継続すると強調した。

リトアニアのブドリス外相は「欧州の政治情勢を注視している」と述べ、各国の選挙が今後の支援を左右する要因の１つになっていると指摘。その上で、一部の国が支援に消極的になって「ウクライナを強く支持する国がさらに１つ抜けたとしても、他の国々が支える。これはわれわれ自身の利益だからだ」と語った。

エストニアのツァフクナ外相は、選挙への懸念よりもウクライナが直面する喫緊の課題を優先すべきだと強調するとともに「重要なのは選挙だけではない。ウクライナだ」と述べた。

ツァフクナ氏によると、８月にウクライナを訪問した際、同国政府当局者は冬を迎えることへの懸念を強めており、特に防空能力の不足や長距離攻撃計画を拡大するための資金不足を訴えていた。ゼレンスキー大統領からも、政治的な枠組みを脇に置き、必要な支援を実際に届けるよう求められたと明かしたツァフクナ氏は「今は来年の選挙がどうなるかを考えている余裕はない」と話した。

フランスでは極右政党、国民連合（ＲＮ）指導者のマリーヌ・ルペン氏が２４日、大統領に選出された場合でも、ウクライナ軍兵士の訓練や軍事装備の供与、有志連合への支援を続ける考えを表明した。一方で、ウクライナに無制限に資金を提供する時代は終わるとの立場を示して「もはやウクライナへの財政支援を提供することはできない。残念だが、われわれにはその余力がない」と述べた。

ドイツでは、極右「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が今月、東部で行われた２つの州選挙で勝利し、全国の世論調査でも首位に立っている。ＡｆＤは、メルツ首相によるウクライナ支援を費用がかかり過ぎ、ロシアを不必要に刺激するものだと批判し、ロシアとのエネルギー関係の回復も主要政策に掲げる。

ポーランドのシコルスキ外相は、フランスの右派勢力について「何かを理解したように見える。それはプラスだ」と評価。一方ドイツについては「親ロシア的な極右がドイツのナショナリズムを復活させようとしているように見え、懸念している」と警戒感をのぞかせた。

ただフィンランドのストゥブ大統領は、欧州では過去にもウクライナ支援を弱めるとみられた政党が有権者の支持を集めたが、懸念は杞憂に終わったと指摘した。ストゥブ氏は「民主主義では振り子が左から右へ、時には極端な方向へ振れる」と説明。イタリアのメローニ首相が選出された際にもウクライナや欧州への悪影響が懸念されたが「実際には特にウクライナに関して前向きな影響しかなかった」と主張した。

またストゥブ氏は、ロシアやウクライナに近い国々は支援を継続する一方、より離れた国では一定の距離を置く動きが出る可能性があると言及しつつも、変化があっても支援の程度にとどまり、根本的な政策転換にはならないとの見通しを示した。

ウクライナのシビハ外相も、欧州各国の選挙日程を注意深く見守っているとした上で、長期的な支援に自信を表明。「もちろん、幾つかのリスクはある」と認め、ウクライナ問題を各国の国内政争の材料にしないよう求め、「欧州の英知を信じている」と付け加えた。

item.title: トランプ氏、イランのホルムズ再開提案を拒否 中間選挙後に空爆再開示唆と報道
